Three-head-tall proportions; do not turn hero into white mask knight. Art direction: confident clean near-black ink contours, two or three broad flat painted values, very sparse texture, strongly readable silhouette, dark foreground framing, clear playable middle plane, low-contrast atmospheric backgrounds. Poetic underwater ruins of a DEAD whale, tiny shell shelters and red repair knots, no human architecture. A strong action-adventure visual explanation, NOT just a pretty landscape.
